title: Single Number
description: Given a non-empty array of integers `nums`, every element appears twice except for one. Find that single one in linear runtime and constant extra space.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
hints: Use XOR bitwise operation: `x ^ x = 0` and `x ^ 0 = x`.
XOR-ing all numbers cancels out duplicate pairs.
The remainder is the single unique number in O(n) time and O(1) space.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    ans = 0
    for x in nums: ans ^= x
    print(ans)
